info.name: MACUTION - Microservice Based Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection organized by microservice.

Services:
- User Service (port 8080) → Gateway: /api/user/*, /api/admin/*
- Product Service (port 5088) → Gateway: /api/product/*
- Admin Service (port 5087) → Gateway: /api/admin-request/*, /api/admin-product/*
- Verify Service (port 5089) → Gateway: /api/verify/*
- Auction Service (port 5001) → Gateway: /api/auctions/*, /api/Watchlist/*, /hubs/auction/*

SignalR Hub: ws://localhost:5000/hubs/auction?access_token={{seller_token}}

Hub Client Methods: JoinAuction(auctionId), ListenToAuction(auctionId), StopViewing(auctionId), LeaveAuction(auctionId)
Hub Server Events: BidPlaced, AuctionStarted, AuctionClosed, AuctionEndingSoon, TimerTick, ViewerCountUpdated, AuctionAborted, AuctionUnverified, AuctionUpdated, AuctionMessage, GetWatchListDetail, GeneralAuction

item.name: User Service
UserController

request.description:
Controller: UserController.CreateUser
Binding: [FromForm] UserCreateDto
Auth: None

Fields: Name (string), Password (string), Email (string), Phone (string), Address (string), Role (string, default "SELLER"), ProfilePicture (string?), file (IFormFile?)

Controller: UserController.Login
Binding: [FromBody] UserLoginDto
Auth: None

Fields: Email (string), Password (string), Role (string, default "SELLER")
Response: { Id, Name, Email, Role, imageUrl, Phone, Address, token }

Controller: UserController.ChangeProfile
Binding: [FromForm] changeProfileDto
Auth: [Authorize] — Bearer token required

All fields optional: Name, Phone, Address, ProfilePicture, Email, Password, confirmPassword, file (IFormFile), publicId

item.description:
Route: api/user
Handles seller/user registration, login, and profile management.

item.name: AdminController

request.description:
Controller: AdminController.requestSignup
Binding: [FromBody] UserCreateDto (NO [FromForm] — JSON body)
Auth: None

Fields: Name, Password, Email, Phone, Address, Role (set to "ADMIN")

Controller: AdminController.Login
Binding: [FromBody] UserLoginDto
Auth: None

Fields: Email (string), Password (string)
Note: Route is case-sensitive 'Login' (capital L) as defined in [HttpPost("Login")]

Controller: AdminController.GetProfile
Binding: query param userid (int?, optional)
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "ADMIN")]

If userid is null, uses the logged-in admin's ID from token.
Response: AdminDetail { id, Name, Email, Phone, Address, imageUrl, Role, obj (RequestDetailDto?) }

Controller: UserController.ChangeProfile
Binding: [FromForm] changeProfileDto
Auth: [Authorize] — Bearer token required

All fields optional: Name, Phone, Address, ProfilePicture, Email, Password, confirmPassword, file (IFormFile), publicId

Controller: AdminController.GetProfile
Binding: query param userid (int?, optional)
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "ADMIN")]

If userid is null, uses the logged-in admin's ID from token.
Response: AdminDetail { id, Name, Email, Phone, Address, imageUrl, Role, obj (RequestDetailDto?) }

item.description:
Route: api/admin
Handles admin signup, login, and admin profile. This controller lives in the User service but is accessed via the adminCluster gateway route.

Port: 8080 | Gateway routes: /api/user/* → userCluster, /api/admin/* → adminCluster (both proxy to User service)

Controllers:
- UserController [Route("api/[controller]")] → api/user
- AdminController [Route("api/[controller]")] → api/admin

item.name: Product Service

formdata.value: A rare vintage watch from the 1960s in excellent condition.

request.description:
Controller: ProductController.createProduct
Binding: [FromBody] ProductCreate (NO [FromForm] attribute)
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "SELLER,USER")]

Fields: name (string?), description (string?), date (DateTime — product purchase date)
Note: user_id is set from token, not from body. images field exists in DTO but cannot be sent via JSON — use the separate /images endpoint for file uploads.

Response: ProductDto { id, product_buy_date, user_id, Name, description, verified, images[], AuctionStartTime, AuctionEndTime }

Controller: ProductController.getallProducts
Binding: [FromBody] ProductAll
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "SELLER,USER,ADMIN")]

Fields: mine (bool, default false), verified (bool, default false), searchName (string?), productId (int?), createdFrom (DateTime?), createdTo (DateTime?), buyFrom (DateTime?), buyTo (DateTime?), page (int, default 1), size (int, default 10)

Note: id is set from token (not from body)

Controller: ProductController.updateproduct
Binding: [FromForm] ProductUpdate (extends AddImage)
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "SELLER,USER")]

ProductUpdate fields: name (string?), description (string?), date (DateTime?), AuctionStartTime (DateTime?), AuctionEndTime (DateTime?), ids (List<int>? — image IDs to remove), images (List<IFormFile>? — new images)
Route param: productId (int) — set from URL

Note: id field in DTO is set from route param, not body

Controller: ProductController.addImages
Binding: [FromForm] AddImage
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "SELLER,USER")]

Fields: id (int — product ID), images (List<IFormFile>? — image files)

Controller: ProductController.deleteProductImage
Binding: route params productId (int), imageId (int)
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "SELLER,USER")]

Deletes a specific image from a product. Only the product owner can delete.

Controller: ProductController.deleteproduct
Binding: route param productId (int)
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "SELLER,USER")]

⚠️ CAUTION: Deleting a product triggers 'AuctionAborted' SignalR event if a live auction exists. Run this LAST.

item.description:
Port: 5088 | Gateway route: /api/product/* → productCluster

Controller: ProductController [Route("api/Product")]

AdminRequestController

Grants seller rights to user after verification.

Controller: AdminRequestController.RevokeUserRights

Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "ADMIN")] + [TypeFilter(typeof(VerifyFilter))]

Controller: AdminRequestController.RevokeVerification

Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "ADMIN")] + [TypeFilter(typeof(VerifyFilter))]

item.description:
Route: api/admin-request
All endpoints require [Authorize(Roles = "ADMIN")] except details (AllowAnonymous).

item.name: Verify Service

request.description:
Controller: VerifyController.VerifyProduct
Binding: [FromBody] VerifyProductRequest
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "ADMIN")]

Fields: ProductId (int), SellerId (int), description (string, default empty)
Creates a verification record for the product.

Controller: VerifyController.UnverifyProduct
Binding: [FromBody] ProductUnverify
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "ADMIN")]

Fields: productId (int), description (string, default "Admin Unverify this product due to some reasons")
Cancels live auction if exists, triggers 'AuctionUnverified' SignalR event.

Controller: VerifyController.GetVerifyStatus
Binding: route param productId (int)
Auth: [AllowAnonymous] — no token needed

Response: VerifyStatusResponse { ProductId, IsVerified, VerifierId, VerifiedTime, Description, user_id }

Controller: VerifyController.GetProductsUniversal
Binding: [FromBody] FilterVerify
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "ADMIN")]

Fields: page (int, default 1), pagesize (int, default 10), name (string?), verified (bool, default false), pending (bool, default false), mine (bool, default false)
Note: verifierId is set from token, not body

exec: var id = jsonData.data.id || jsonData.data.Id || jsonData.data.AuctionId || jsonData.data.auctionId;

request.description:
Controller: VerifyController.createAuctions
Binding: [FromBody] CreateAuctionRequest
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "SELLER,USER")]

Fields: ProductId (int), StartingPrice (decimal), ReservePrice (decimal?), MinBidIncrement (decimal, default 1.00), StartDate (DateTime), EndDate (DateTime)

⚠️ Product MUST be verified before calling this. The Verify service validates verification status before publishing CreateAuction event via RabbitMQ.
Pre-request script auto-sets start=now+2min, end=start+1hr.

item.description:

item.name: Auction Service
AuctionController

request.description:
Controller: AuctionController.GetAll
Binding: [FromQuery] AuctionFilterRequest
Auth: [Authorize(Roles = "USER,SELLER")]

Query params: Status (AuctionStatus? enum), MinPrice (decimal?), MaxPrice (decimal?), FilterStartDate (DateTime?), FilterEndDate (DateTime?), Page (int, default 1), PageSize (int, default 20), name (string?), mine (bool, default false), productId (int?)
Note: mineid is set from token

Response: PagedResponse<AuctionResponse> { Items[], TotalCount, Page, PageSize, TotalPages }

Controller: AuctionController.GetById
Binding: route param auctionId (int)
Auth: [Authorize]

Response: AuctionDetailResponse extends AuctionResponse { HighestBid (BidResponse?), RecentBids (List<BidResponse>), WatcherCount (int), LiveViewerCount (long), Winner (WinnerResponse?), win (bool) }

Controller: AuctionController.Update
Binding: route param auctionId (int), [FromBody] UpdateAuctionRequest
Auth: [Authorize]

All fields optional: StartingPrice (decimal?), ReservePrice (decimal?), MinBidIncrement (decimal?), StartDate (DateTime?), EndDate (DateTime?)
Only auction creator can update. Triggers 'AuctionUpdated' SignalR event.

Controller: AuctionController.Cancel
Binding: route param auctionId (int)
Auth: [Authorize]

Only auction creator can cancel.

Controller: AuctionController.GetMyCreated
Binding: none (userId from token)
Auth: [Authorize]

Response: List<AuctionResponse>

Controller: AuctionController.GetMyParticipated
Binding: [FromQuery] ParticipatedFilter (extends AuctionFilterRequest)
Auth: [Authorize]

Extra field: win (bool, default false) — filter only won auctions
Response: PagedResponse<AuctionResponse>

item.description:
Route: api/auctions
All endpoints require [Authorize]. Most require SELLER/USER role.

request.description:
Controller: BidController.PlaceBid

Adds auction to user's watchlist. Sends 'GetWatchListDetail' SignalR event to the user.

Controller: WatchlistController.GetWatched

item.name: SignalR Hub (AuctionHub)
item.description:
WebSocket endpoint: /hubs/auction
Auth: [Authorize] — pass token as query param

Connection URL: ws://localhost:5000/hubs/auction?access_token={token}

--- Client → Server Methods ---
• JoinAuction(auctionId: string) — Join auction room, increment viewer count
• ListenToAuction(auctionId: string) — Listen to auction events without viewer count
• StopViewing(auctionId: string) — Stop viewing but stay listening
• LeaveAuction(auctionId: string) — Leave auction room completely

--- Server → Client Events ---
• BidPlaced(data) — New bid placed, broadcast to auction group
• AuctionStarted({auctionId}) — Auction status changed to Live, broadcast to auctiondetail group
• AuctionClosed(data) — Auction ended with winner info
• AuctionEndingSoon({auctionId, minutesRemaining}) — Warning before auction ends
• TimerTick({auctionId, secondsRemaining}) — Countdown timer
• ViewerCountUpdated(count) — Live viewer count changed
• AuctionAborted({auctionId, reason}) — Product deleted during auction
• AuctionUnverified({auctionId, reason}) — Product un-verified during auction
• AuctionUpdated(data) — Auction details changed
• AuctionMessage({message}) — General message to auction group
• GetWatchListDetail(data) — Watchlist update sent to specific user
• GeneralAuction(message) — General auction creation notification

Port: 5001 | Gateway routes:
- /api/auctions/* → auctionCluster
- /api/Watchlist/* → watchListCluster
- /hubs/auction/* → hubCluster (SignalR WebSocket)

Controllers:
- AuctionController [Route("api/auctions")]
- BidController [Route("api/auctions/{auctionId:int}/bids")]
- WatchlistController [Route("api/[controller]")]

SignalR Hub: AuctionHub mapped at /hubs/auction
